missionary

He was SPG missionary at Maritzburg 1858-61 and Archdeacon of Maritzburg 1861-5.

He married (1861) at Bishopstoke, Natal, Alice Mackenzie, youngest sister of CF Mackenzie [Genealogical Memoranda Relating to the Grubbe Family (1893)]
